state_name: 低/高電圧または過温度によるreduced assist
required_dtc: Voltage-related DTC, over-temperature DTC, reduced assist related DTC, manual mode related DTC, equivalent program-specific DTC.
required_freeze_frame_or_extended_data: Supply voltage at event, ECU/motor temperature, motor current or assist command if available, vehicle speed, steering angle/rate, occurrence count, key cycle status.
required_limit_or_mode_state: Reduced assist mode, manual mode, assist limit flag, thermal limit flag, voltage protection state, recovery state.
required_context: Low/high battery voltage, charging system state, ambient/underhood temperature if available, repeated key cycle persistence, recent stop-start or high steering load.
required_repair_feedback: Repair result, charging system repair, battery replacement, connector repair, recurrence after repair, no trouble found result.
eps_supplier_can_define: Meaning of reduced assist under voltage/thermal context, diagnostic reading order, EPS internal fault vs power/thermal context boundary, customer/service wording.
needs_oem_fleet_platform: Event capture across key cycles, non-EPS power system repair results, fleet dispatch decision, service outcome feedback.
can_say_without_feedback: Voltage or thermal context may affect steering assist; inspect power/thermal context before EPS component judgment.
cannot_say_without_feedback: EPS remaining lifetime, replacement date, safety guarantee, root cause, warranty cost reduction.
data_boundary_decision: Proceed to one-case diagnostic reading order; no RUL without feedback loop.
next_check: Can existing DTC/freeze frame/extended data retain voltage, temperature, assist mode, and key cycle persistence?

state_name: 電気接続 / harness / network由来の複合症状
required_dtc: Steering DTC, network communication DTC, power supply DTC, related ECU DTCs, body/chassis/powertrain DTCs appearing in same event window.
required_freeze_frame_or_extended_data: Multiple ECU DTC timestamps, voltage at event, module reset/loss communication flags, steering assist status, occurrence timing, simultaneous symptom flags if available.
required_limit_or_mode_state: Reduced/loss assist state, module offline/reset state, communication degraded state, fail-safe or fallback state.
required_context: IPC/radio/HVAC/engine/stability symptoms, harness/cable inspection context, power/ground condition, network topology and affected modules.
required_repair_feedback: Harness repair result, connector repair result, module replacement/no replacement, recurrence after repair, service workflow result.
eps_supplier_can_define: EPS replacement-before-boundary, fault grouping wording, steering symptom as affected system vs root cause boundary, recommended diagnostic reading order.
needs_oem_fleet_platform: Vehicle-wide DTC collection, harness inspection records, repair results, service workflow ownership, fleet/platform event correlation.
can_say_without_feedback: Steering symptom appears with vehicle-level electrical/network compound symptoms; prioritize power/harness/network diagnosis before steering replacement.
cannot_say_without_feedback: EPS root cause, EPS replacement date, safety guarantee, warranty responsibility, complete component localization without vehicle-wide data.
data_boundary_decision: Proceed to fault grouping map; supplier-owned value is boundary explanation, not platform diagnosis.
next_check: Can same-case data bundle steering symptom with power/network/other ECU symptoms and repair result?

state_name: 外部信号または通信validity異常
required_dtc: Steering DTC, external ECU DTC, invalid signal DTC, U-code or signal plausibility DTC, program-specific dependency DTC.
required_freeze_frame_or_extended_data: Signal validity at event, substituted/default value status, external ECU DTC snapshot, steering assist status, message timestamp, occurrence count.
required_limit_or_mode_state: Signal fallback state, degraded input state, assist reduction triggered by invalid input, warning/message state.
required_context: CAN/LIN signal availability, external ECU health, coolant/vehicle speed/torque/ADAS signal dependency depending on program, network communication context.
required_repair_feedback: External ECU repair, software update, signal wiring repair, steering component not replaced, recurrence/no recurrence.
eps_supplier_can_define: Signal dependency table, invalid signal explanation, steering module affected-by-external-signal boundary, service note wording.
needs_oem_fleet_platform: External ECU DTC access, network logs, service tool authority, repair outcome, cross-domain owner routing.
can_say_without_feedback: Steering assist message may be driven by external signal validity; validate external ECU/signal context before steering component judgment.
cannot_say_without_feedback: EPS internal failure, root cause, replacement timing, complete responsibility assignment without external ECU data.
data_boundary_decision: Proceed to signal dependency table; strong triage value, weak RUL value.
next_check: Which external signals are steering-relevant, and can invalid/substituted states be observed?

required_dtc: Thermal protection DTC, motor/control temperature DTC, assist limit DTC, equivalent occurrence/history DTC if available.
required_freeze_frame_or_extended_data: ECU/motor temperature, motor current, steering angle/rate, lock-to-lock repetition, vehicle speed, duration, occurrence count, recovery after cooling.
required_limit_or_mode_state: Thermal protection active, assist limit active, steering motor offline/protection state, recovery state.
required_context: Low-speed repeated steering, high-load steering, ambient/underhood temperature, driver usage context if available.
required_repair_feedback: Cooling/recovery confirmation, no part replacement result, recurrence under same usage, service explanation acceptance.
eps_supplier_can_define: Thermal protection meaning, normal protection vs fault boundary, load feature definition, no-immediate-replacement wording.
needs_oem_fleet_platform: Actual usage context, high-resolution temperature timeline, customer usage explanation, repair/recurrence result.
can_say_without_feedback: Steering load and thermal protection context observed; verify cooling/recovery and recurrence before component replacement.
cannot_say_without_feedback: EPS lifetime, replacement date, root cause, guarantee that behavior is normal without program-specific thresholds.
data_boundary_decision: Proceed to thermal explanation template; business output is explanation/triage more than maintenance forecast.
next_check: Can existing diagnostics capture thermal state, assist limit, and recovery after cooling?

state_name: DTC履歴とreduced assistの再発監視
required_dtc: Current/historical DTC, reduced assist related DTC, status aging, confirmed/pending/history status, recurrence DTC.
required_freeze_frame_or_extended_data: DTC occurrence count, first/last occurrence, mileage/time since occurrence, status aging, freeze frame at repeated events, service cleared status.
required_limit_or_mode_state: Reduced assist history, current vs historical status, degraded/fallback history if available.
required_context: Driving/usage context at repeated events, temperature/voltage context, communication context, service clear/relearn context.
required_repair_feedback: Repair result, recurrence/no recurrence after repair, part replacement/no replacement, work time, Techline/escalation result.
eps_supplier_can_define: DTC history reading principle, recurrence monitoring boundary, why DTC history alone is not replacement prediction.
needs_oem_fleet_platform: OEM/service feedback loop, repair records, fleet recurrence monitoring, work order result, platform correlation.
can_say_without_feedback: Reduced assist recurrence pattern can be monitored; connect recurrence and service outcome before maintenance forecast.
cannot_say_without_feedback: RUL, replacement date, failure prediction, warranty reduction from DTC history alone.
data_boundary_decision: Proceed only with dependency; Hold if repair feedback loop is unavailable.
next_check: Can DTC history, recurrence interval, and repair outcome be joined in one case trail?
